scope: UNFOLDIQ managed artifacts (repository + validation projects). Folder hierarchy is navigation only and never decides retention.

DURABLE.rule: Retain. Reclassification requires a reviewed migration with journal proof.

RETENTION_MANAGED.rule: Archive or purge only after policy evaluation (future-dependency gate + quarantine where required).

REGENERABLE.rule: Purge allowed only with a proven rebuild contract (command + lock/source + determinism class) and futureDependencyStatus NONE or REGENERABLE_SAFE.

EPHEMERAL.rule: Purge allowed when no active process and no current evidence requires the bytes.

GOLDEN.rule: Immutable at application-policy level. Never purged, never replaced in place; supersede only through the Golden process.

immediateDeleteAllowedOnlyWhen: retentionClass is EPHEMERAL or proven R0/R1 REGENERABLE
no future exact dependency (futureDependencyStatus NONE or REGENERABLE_SAFE)

regenerationClasses.R0: trivial/local: seconds/minutes, deterministic, no provider, no operator — DELETE allowed when unused
regenerationClasses.R1: local but non-trivial deterministic build/render — DELETE allowed when rebuild contract is proven
regenerationClasses.R2: expensive local (long render/heavy compute/large download) — prefer KEEP/ARCHIVE
regenerationClasses.R3: external free/non-credit with drift risk — prefer ARCHIVE when future use is plausible
regenerationClasses.R4: paid/external generation (credits or changed output) — KEEP/ARCHIVE, never delete to save space
regenerationClasses.R5: manual/operator-dependent (approval, ceremony, QA, selection) — KEEP/ARCHIVE, never delete to save space

deleteRule: Exact future dependency, canonical/QA/provenance/history/Golden evidence, paid recreation, operator recreation, or non-deterministic recreation → KEEP_EXACT or ARCHIVE_RECOMMENDED. Unknown state never defaults to deletion.
